blind.description: A rectangular crypt or catacomb wall segment consisting of a dark grey-green dressed stone architectural frame filled with tightly stacked human skulls and skeletal remains. The frame features a beveled capstone, segmented ashlar jambs, and a sturdy stone threshold. Both sides of the wall showcase the bone-filled interior with stylized bone-tan and ochre coloring and shadowed crevices. The structure is fully solid with clean, continuous geometry.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular grey stone slab divided in half across its width by a single straight seam.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands approximately 7.5 feet tall (noticeably taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 3.5 feet wide, and about 1 foot thick.
